name: proofrail-workspace
description: Working repository for an independent software build verification network.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @proofrail/registry-0g check && pnpm --filter @proofrail/sandbox-0g check && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/runner-local/test/*.test.ts packages/cli/test/*.test.ts packages/storage-0g/test/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @proofrail/contracts check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @proofrail/registry-0g test && pnpm --filter @proofrail/sandbox-0g test && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/runner-local/test/*.test.ts packages/cli/test/*.test.ts packages/storage-0g/test/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @proofrail/contracts test
